summary: Sono Group N.V. filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, reporting a Share Purchase Agreement with certain private purchasers for 283,500 ordinary shares at the prior-day Nasdaq closing bid price, sold under an existing effective Form S-3 shelf via a Rule 424(b) prospectus supplement (a routine registered takedown, occurring in a 09 Crypto Assets-tagged filing). The agreement caps issuances at 19.9% of voting power or outstanding shares under Nasdaq rules and restricts proceeds to working capital, barring debt repayment, buybacks, and litigation settlements. No advisor, premium, or close date stated; listing application filed.
